description: Native balance and the major tokens (USDC, USDT, EURC, DAI, WETH, cbBTC and WBTC where listed) of an EVM address on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, or chain=all, with USD values from Coinbase spot prices. One Multicall3 call per chain. Zero balances are omitted, and only the listed tokens are checked, not every token the wallet holds. Related tools on this server, for a different need: evm_address when you need native balance, nonce and account type of an EVM address; evm_balance when you need ERC-20 balance of an address for one token contract. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon or all
